CLASSROOM PRACTICE

Start with a small, deliberate change

All 100 reference pages ↗
Check & Adapt

Mini-whiteboards for diagnosis

Using standardised, simultaneous board responses to gather valid whole-class data quickly enough to adapt in the moment.

Practical guidance↗
Drive Thinking for All

Cold calling

Asking the question to the whole class, allowing thinking time and then warmly inviting a selected student to respond.

Practical guidance↗
Check & Adapt

Hinge questions

A pre-planned diagnostic question at a critical point where the class response determines whether teaching moves on, consolidates or reteaches.

Practical guidance↗
Secure learning through practice

Guided practice

Short supported rehearsal in which the teacher and students co-work examples, make responses visible and correct errors before independent release.

Practical guidance↗
Explain

Thinking aloud

Verbalising the expert's internal decisions, monitoring and self-correction while completing a task.

Practical guidance↗
Feedback to improve

Whole-class feedback and Show Call

Reviewing a set of work to identify patterns, then teaching from common strengths, misconceptions and strategically selected examples rather than writing repeated individual comments.
